subject.title: improve: reduce GPT-5.6 coding harness overhead

question: Can the repository accept the private-QA environment gate as the only condition that narrows a configured Codex `danger-full-access` sandbox, after confirming those variables are never inherited by ordinary runtime launches?
rationale: This is an intentional security-boundary and test-harness design choice; source-level correctness alone cannot determine the desired operational trust boundary for these environment variables.

options.title: Verify scoped QA inheritance
options.body: Confirm the QA child-process construction clears or narrowly injects both variables, then merge after rebasing and refreshing focused proof.

options.title: Make the boundary explicit
options.body: Require a stronger dedicated test or a more isolated configuration channel before accepting the sandbox override.

options.title: Pause the sandbox portion
options.body: Split or defer the private-QA sandbox override if the environment isolation contract cannot be demonstrated clearly.

recommendation.title: Verify scoped QA inheritance
recommendation.body: Confirm the QA child-process construction clears or narrowly injects both variables, then merge after rebasing and refreshing focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows direct ownership of the private-QA Codex sandbox and native patch-containment implementation.
